raw_segments.text: The maintenance of the existing institutions of the several states depends in some measure
upon the maintenance of the union itself.
It is therefore important in the first instance to inquire into the probable fate of the union.
One point may indeed be assumed at once.
If the present confederation were dissolved, it appears to me to be incontestable that
the states of which it is now composed would not return to their original isolated condition,
but that several unions would then be formed in the place of one.
It is not my intention to inquire into the principles upon which these new unions would
probably be established, but merely to show what the causes are which may affect the dismemberment
